scope_label: average corrective-maintenance duration for repairable equipment
definition: For a repairable system, mean time to repair (MTTR) is the average counted downtime needed to restore it after a failure.
explanation: For a set of failures, divide the counted repair downtime by the number of failures; state which delays the downtime includes.
MTTR concerns restoration time, whereas mean time between failures concerns operating time between failures. Neither figure alone fully determines availability.
